create_DetectorNode: create a DetectorNode instance with a camera topic and blob detector for ROS-based image detection
run_DetectorNode_spin: run the DetectorNode spin loop to continuously detect blobs and publish results to ROS topics
close_DetectorNode: close the DetectorNode to clean up ROS topics and publishers gracefully
review_DetectorNode_publish_centers: review the DetectorNode _publish_centers method that publishes blob center coordinates to ROS point publishers
review_DetectorNode_publish_detections: review the DetectorNode _publish_detections method that publishes blob visualization images to ROS image publishers
